title: Mount Athos dedicated to Mary and closed to women

tellings.quote: women to this day cannot go on Mount Athos, step foot on Mount Athos, because it's dedicated completely to Mary at the exclusion of all women.

plain: Mount Athos in Greece is said to be devoted entirely to Mary, so much so that women may not set foot on it even today. A guest named Ralph Larson says this to Michels in passing, describing the mountain as dedicated to Mary "at the exclusion of all women."
